Publish.LongDescription:
# Station Suitability Overlay
Renders a heatmap over the terrain that scores every 64 m tile for transit station placement, so you can see at a glance where a new bus stop or metro station would serve the most people.
## Scoring
Each tile is scored with a weighted multi-criteria formula over a 400 m catchment:
- **Demand** — residents within the catchment - **Jobs** — workplaces within the catchment - **Coverage penalty** — existing stops of the selected mode reduce the score nearby, avoiding redundant stations - **Accessibility** — road network density around the tile
The top 5% of tiles are highlighted at full opacity. Bus and Metro presets ship with sensible default weights, and all four weights are adjustable live.
## Usage
Open the **Station Suitability** panel in the top-right corner of the screen, enable the overlay, pick a mode, and tune the weights. The overlay recalculates automatically when stops change, or on demand via the Recalculate button.
